integrity: The code enumeration and affine-flat census are reproducible finite tests; an all-dimensional proof is supplied in RESULT.md. The published minimum distance is not claimed as new. Originality is based on identifiable public comparison, not independently certified priority.
scientific_limitations: Exact complete enumerator only for degree-two binary Reed–Muller codes ordered by increasing binary integer and integral width strictly above five eighths of the length. Results depend on order; smaller widths, arbitrary permutations and higher degrees are not classified.
title: The eight-word high-window tail of quadratic Reed–Muller \(b\)-symbol weight spectra
